# William Valera · IT Manager (Responsable de IT)

> IT Manager based in Valencia, Spain, with 20+ years in technology and systems. He runs all the technology of a distribution company with 120 users and 4 sites in Spain, Portugal and Italy, reporting directly to senior management: ERP (Microsoft Dynamics NAV), infrastructure, security, support and vendors. He also builds in-house, with AI agents, the applications and automations the business needs, reviewing and approving every change that reaches production.

## Profile
- Current role (2024–present): IT Manager, Arte Regal Import, S.L. (Valencia). Scope: 120 users, 4 sites in three countries, 4 IT vendors.
- 2018–2024: IT Consultant, ERP implementation (Microsoft Dynamics NAV), same company.
- 2005–2018: systems, support, networking and technical management roles in Venezuela.
- Education: Systems Analyst. Languages: Spanish (native), English (intermediate).

## Capabilities
- ERP: Microsoft Dynamics NAV, C/AL, NAS and Job Queue, SOAP, EDI.
- Data engineering: central data platform, incremental ETL from SQL Server to MySQL/MariaDB, validation and atomic publishing.
- Applied AI: tool-using agents, context-aware translation, multimodal image validation, voice transcription.
- IT management: vendor management, purchasing and investment studies, in-house ServiceDesk, remote management of workstations and servers (RMM), GDPR and disaster recovery plan.
- AI-driven development: a team of 9 specialised AI agents with separated duties, restricted permissions and human approval.
- Full-stack and offline applications: FastAPI, Next.js, React, TypeScript, PWA.
- Business automation, security, infrastructure and operations.
- EU regulatory compliance: EUDR, CBAM and PPWR supplier tracking; CLP/GHS product-safety labelling.
